answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 13190 Country: SE Title: assalamualaikum,i am a bangladeshi now living in sweden with my husband and my mother in law.my husband is a very good person and i am really very happy with him.my problem is my mother in law,she is not happy about me.though she is the one who choose me for his son but now she is very unhappy.she dont let me tell people about my hometown.she dont like my hometown and she says my parents didnt gave anything during the wedding.i am very upset about everything.please suggest me any dua or surah.i read namaaz regularly.i want to know can sunni people recite naad e ali?please give answer and dua in english.thank you so much. Question: assalamualaikum,i am a bangladeshi now living in sweden with my husband and my mother in law.my husband is a very good person and i am really very happy with him.my problem is my mother in law,she is not happy about me.though she is the one who choose me for his son but now she is very unhappy.she dont let me tell people about my hometown.she dont like my hometown and she says my parents didnt gave anything during the wedding.i am very upset about everything.please suggest me any dua or surah.i read namaaz regularly.i want to know can sunni people recite naad e ali?please give answer and dua in english.thank you so much. Answer ID: 13190 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1271/1000=H/1430) Recite the following ayah 11 times after every salah with durood 11 times before and after. Repeat the same while going to bed and sleep according to sunnah in the state of wudhu: وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِنِّي وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَى عَيْنِي (16:39) (2) Reciting Naad-e-Ali is unlawful, you must not recite it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
